audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 overstates a lane Renekton takes at 49.01% over 1365 games.
audit.why: Near-even results with a real Renekton window at levels 1-2 is a tricky lane, not a near-counter. The mirror moved its own side to 4/10, and 6.5/10 is the consistent inverse.
audit.corrected: diffRating 6.5/10 with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t reworded to match. carryRating 8/10 left as is — her Liandry's/Rylai's game genuinely carries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5 and 6 disagreed with the packet chart and with the page's own captions: Level 1 was given to Lillia while levels 3, 4-5, first item and two items were given to Renekton.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the mirror both read Renekton / Skill / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia. The content whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] already describe Lillia taking over at exactly those stages — the side tokens were inverted against the file's own prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's (7, 5, 3, 2, 3, 3, 3); whys[0] reworded so Level 1 reads as Renekton's, and the four contradicting full-layer whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names are swapped between slots: spikes[1].text calls the ultimate 'Dream-Laden Bough AoE sleep' and wants.foe[2] calls Lilting Lullaby a 'passive DOT'. Blooming Blows' true damage is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Dream-Laden Bough is the PASSIVE — hitting a champion with a skill applies max-Health damage over time. Lilting Lullaby is the ultimate: it makes enemies already carrying Dream Dust go Drowsy and then sleep, and they take extra damage when woken. So the ultimate cannot open on a clean target — the DOT has to land first, which is the actual counterplay. Blooming Blows deals magic damage with extra TRUE damage on the outer edge and stacks her move speed on every spell hit, so armour is the wrong answer and she out-paces your 300-range W.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected in spikes[1].text and wants.foe[2] with the DOT prerequisite stated; the true damage and move-speed stacking written into whys[3], dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d; the 1.5s empowered stun into wants.you[0].

audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s — genuinely trackable, and the page is right to gate every level-6+ engage on it. The number is now stated in spikes[1].text.

notes: Two ability names were swapped between slots on the live page: the ultimate was printed as 'Dream-Laden Bough' (that is the passive) and the passive DOT was printed as 'Lilting Lullaby' (that is the ultimate). The consequence is a real gameplay error, because it hid the prerequisite that makes the ultimate playable-around: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust, so refusing the DOT chip is the counterplay. The packet's suspectNames caught the first of the two; the second was not flagged. diffRating moved from 7.5 to 6.5/10 on a 49.01% lane — flagged as Medium confidence since it is a judgement call rather than a kit fact.
